identified_issues: Critical orthogonal diagnostic sensor HE-SNIFF-01 was offline during the transient event, preventing differentiation between benign thermal contraction and catastrophic dynamic face seal fracture.
Telemetry ambiguity exists due to identical pressure (-1.15 bar) and acoustic frequency (44.2 Hz) signatures for both benign thermal duct contraction and hazardous face seal fracture.
evidence: PT-401 recorded an uncommanded pressure drop of Delta P = -1.15 bar over 140 ms at 14:22:10.450Z, within the overlapping -1.0 to -1.3 bar range for both phenomena.
ACC-102 registered resonant acoustic vibration at 44.2 Hz, falling within the 40-48 Hz shared band for both duct contraction and shaft resonance.
HE-SNIFF-01 log at 14:22:00.000Z confirms sensor status was OFFLINE_CALIBRATION_PURGE with isolated port.
HE-SNIFF-01 telemetry log at 14:22:10.600Z confirms 'Secondary purge helium concentration: N/A (no sample stream acquired during transient interval). Integrity: UNKNOWN.'
recommended_action: Suspend countdown advancement under HELD status. Restore HE-SNIFF-01 to active online sampling mode and perform a static helium mass-spectrometry leak check on the secondary inter-seal cavity purge line. Recertify seal integrity prior to resuming cryogenic chilldown.
